purpose: AS-01/VS-01 audit: verify the audio/video streaming session helpers own no second persistence, dedup or reconciliation engine — durable stream-session reconciliation (acks, in-flight attempts, resume) is owned solely by the canonical media_stream_sessions lineage.

modules/audio-streaming.owns: wire encode/decode (seq:int + ts:long + len:int + payload), frames-per-second math, next-expected-sequence and ordering helpers

modules/video-streaming.owns: wire encode/decode (seq:int + keyframe:byte + ts:long + len:int + payload), frames-per-second math, next-expected-frame and ordering helpers

canonicalOwner.semantics: durable per-session ack/receipt and bounded in-flight attempt tracking; reconnect dedup and resume reconciliation live here, not in the wire helpers

guards.noSecondWriter: streaming modules must not import java.sql/javax.sql/jakarta.persistence/Flyway/JDBC or any canonical store — they remain deterministic pure helpers
guards.reconcileAtBoundary: callers reconcile received sequences against media_stream_sessions acks/attempts; the wire helpers never decide resume dedup
guards.boundedWireDecode: decodeFrame enforces the fixed header, declared-length bound, exact-remaining and (video) keyframe-flag validation before allocation
